description: This PHP class 'EmployeeNumber' is part of a reporting filter system in the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base filter field class and implements value normalization, allowing filtering employee data based on employee number within reports.

classes.name: EmployeeNumber
classes.description: A filter field for selecting employees by employee number in reports within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to the query builder for filtering employees by employee number when the operator is 'equal' and the filter value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query for this filter, in this case ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the employee number filter value to a detailed array with employee id, label, and termination status if the employee exists.
